description: List a wallet's most recent transaction signatures, newest first, with slot, time and error status. Use it to find a transaction to inspect with decode_tx. Returns {wallet, count, signatures}. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL) after the 27-call trial. Example: {"wallet":"<wallet address>","limit":5}

limit.description: How many signatures to return, newest first: integer 1-1000 (optional, default 10).

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

wallet.description: Wallet whose transaction history to list: base58 public key, 32-44 characters (required).

name: get_recent_transactions
